info.title: API
info.description: REST API under /api for the mobile app. Every response body is { data, message }; errors carry data: null, and a 400 that names its fields lists them in errors. Authenticated routes take the access token of a session (POST /api/auth/sign-in) as a bearer token; POST /api/auth/refresh exchanges the refresh token for a new session. The app sends X-App-Platform (ios, android) and X-App-Version with every request: below the oldest version the API serves, it answers 426.

errors.description: On a 400 that names its fields: one entry per invalid field, for the client to mark each one.

path.description: The field, as the request named it (nested fields joined with dots).
